answer: Traced field notes do not open a pigment loft. After posting 20.6 POA, the applicant has 21 minutes to reach loft bay LB-8 at the inner delta, lift sealed raven band RB-17 from hook H-4, and brush 0.31 g of creek pigment PG-12 onto card CD-5 so spectrophotometer SP-9 holds a 548.3 nm peak within 0.8 nm for 40 seconds. A second band from the same key cluster, a peak miss over 1.5 nm, or a reused card lot burns the 20.6 POA and bars pigment lofts for four epochs. Two loft clerks rehash the spectrophotometer file and RB-17 serial.
